'''Fried bananas''' is a delightful [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] or snack enjoyed in many cuisines around the world. These sweet, caramelized banana slices offer a perfect balance of crispy and tender textures. Whether served on their own or as a topping for ice cream or pancakes, fried bananas are a simple yet satisfying treat.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 ripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] (optional)
* Vanilla [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]] (optional, for serving)

== Procedure ==

# Heat a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet or frying pan]] over medium heat and melt the butter.
# Add the banana slices to the pan and sprinkle them with brown sugar.
# Cook the bananas for 2–3 minutes on each side or until they turn golden brown and caramelized.
# If desired, sprinkle cinnamon over the bananas during cooking.
# Remove the fried bananas from the pan and serve them hot. Optionally, serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for an extra treat.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Experiment with different spices like nutmeg for unique flavour variations.
* Drizzle honey or chocolate syrup over the fried bananas for added sweetness.
* You can also add a splash of rum or liqueur for an adult twist on this dessert.
* Fried bananas can be served as a topping for pancakes, waffles, or French toast.
* See [[Cookbook:Kele Ka Halwa (Fried Bananas in Milk)|kele ka halwa]] and [[Cookbook:Jamaican Banana Fritters|Jamaican banana fritters]] for similar dishes.
